% ---- DAGS spec v2.0 — print styling, matched to the figures ----
\usepackage{fontspec}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{caption}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{amssymb}
\usepackage{newunicodechar}
\newunicodechar{✓}{\ensuremath{\checkmark}}
\usepackage{colortbl}

% palette, taken from the figures
\definecolor{dagsnavy}{HTML}{15243C}
\definecolor{dagsslate}{HTML}{4A5A75}
\definecolor{dagsmid}{HTML}{6B7C99}
\definecolor{dagsrust}{HTML}{B23A2F}
\definecolor{dagspale}{HTML}{EEF2F8}
\definecolor{dagsline}{HTML}{CFD8E6}

% headings
\titleformat{\section}{\color{dagsnavy}\bfseries\Large}{\thesection}{0.6em}{}
\titleformat{\subsection}{\color{dagsnavy}\bfseries\large}{\thesubsection}{0.6em}{}
\titleformat{\subsubsection}{\color{dagsslate}\bfseries\normalsize}{\thesubsubsection}{0.6em}{}
\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{1.6em}{0.7em}
\titlespacing*{\subsection}{0pt}{1.2em}{0.5em}

% inline code and code blocks
\definecolor{shadecolor}{HTML}{F1F4F9}
\let\oldtexttt\texttt
\renewcommand{\texttt}[1]{{\color{dagsnavy}\oldtexttt{#1}}}

% captions
\captionsetup{font={small,color=dagsslate}, labelfont={bf,color=dagsrust},
              labelsep=period, justification=raggedright, singlelinecheck=false}

% tables: lighter rules, navy headers
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.18}
\arrayrulecolor{dagsline}

% running footer
\pagestyle{fancy}\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0.4pt}
\renewcommand{\footrule}{\color{dagsline}\hrule width\headwidth height\footrulewidth}
\fancyfoot[C]{\footnotesize\color{dagsmid}DAGS specification v2.0\quad·\quad page \thepage\ of \pageref{LastPage}}
\usepackage{lastpage}

% links
\usepackage{hyperref}
\hypersetup{colorlinks=true, linkcolor=dagsnavy, urlcolor=dagsslate,
            pdftitle={DAGS — Distributed AGent Swarm, Specification v2.0}}

% figures sit on their own, never floating away from their chapter
\usepackage{float}
\makeatletter\renewcommand{\fps@figure}{H}\makeatother
